ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio observed; approximately 55% high-intensity white pixels localized to the distal lobe regions and 45% low-intensity black pixels localized to the central notch and marginal boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the outer 60% of both lobes. The right lobe exhibits a high density of low-intensity black stippling and mottling within the white region. The central region near the notch is a solid low-intensity black mass extending to the leading edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees and a vertex depth reaching roughly 12% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge. Notable macro-scale indentations (valleys) observed on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 2/3 distance from the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep from the median notch transitioning to a convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of four discrete, high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (approx. 2-4 pixels in diameter) located on the black field of the central fluke region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss/indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe. Protruding high-relief pixel clusters consistent with biological encrustations (barnacles) are visible on the lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy concentrations of dark-to-light irregular protrusions localized specifically at the extreme lateral terminal points of the fluke lobes.
